alert_first_run.message:
kemono-downloader Ver $1:
This is the first launch after the version update.
The default settings are used.
Please check and adjust them if necessary.

popup_info_text.message: Changing save paths is available on the main settings page.

help_download_text.message: If enabled, text from the "Content" section will be downloaded. All images in this section will be ignored when downloading. All links will be saved as description text.

help_download_images.message: If enabled, images from the "Files" section will be downloaded. Images in the "Content" section will not be downloaded.

help_download_attachments.message: If enabled, attachments from the "Downloads" section will be downloaded.

help_remove_duplicates_by_url.message:
If the list of downloaded files (images or attachments) contains several files that are downloaded from the same address, this setting will affect the download:
  • Enabled - the file will be downloaded only once;
  • Disabled - a copy of the file will be downloaded and saved.

help_base_path.message:
The first, general part of the path where downloaded files will be saved. Depending on the content type, the corresponding part from the fields below will be appended to it, thus forming the full path and file name for saving.
Macros are supported. When downloading files, macros will be replaced with the current values according to their description in the table at the bottom of the page. Only general macros and time macros can be used in this field.

help_text_path.message:
The second part of the path is for saving text. It may optionally contain an additional path calculated relative to the base path and, necessarily, a file name.
Macros are supported. When saving, macros will be replaced with the corresponding values as described in the table at the bottom of the page. Only general macros and time macros can be used for this path.

help_images_path.message:
The second part of the path is for saving images. It may optionally contain an additional path calculated relative to the base path and, necessarily, a file name.
Macros are supported. When saving, macros will be replaced with the corresponding values as described in the table at the bottom of the page. Only general macros, time macros, and image macros can be used for this path.

help_attachments_path.message:
The second part of the path is for saving attachments. It can optionally contain an additional path calculated relative to the base path and, necessarily, a file name.
Macros are supported. When saved, macros will be replaced with the corresponding values as described in the table at the bottom of the page. Only general macros, time macros, and attachment macros can be used for this path.

help_macro_list.message: To copy a macro, click the icon to the left of it.

warning_save_problems.message: An invalid macro was detected. The location of the error is currently highlighted in the text. Remove the added [>][<] characters indicating the error and correct the path.

update_notes_v133_preview_title.message: Files without an original are downloaded as previews

update_notes_v133_preview_desc.message: Files that only have a preview left on the site (preview_only) are downloaded as preview (thumbnail) images instead of from an original address that can't be downloaded. A notification tells you when this happens; in creator downloads it appears only once and the download continues.

update_notes_v133_stuck_title.message: Fixed files waiting to be retried not making progress for a long time

update_notes_v133_stuck_desc.message: If the browser did not start a download within 30 seconds (for example when saving to a NAS), or never confirmed that a stalled download was cancelled, that file kept its slot and held up other files. Now the next files start and that file is retried. Files waiting to be retried now have their own line and use only one slot while new files are waiting, so files on an unresponsive server no longer slow down the rest. When many downloads fail in a short time, the server is treated as overloaded and new downloads pause for 15 seconds before continuing.

update_notes_v133_status_title.message: Progress notification shows why downloads are paused

update_notes_v133_status_desc.message: When downloads pause for a moment, the progress notification now says why: the queue is full and the next post is waiting, or the server looks overloaded and downloads are resting (with the time until they resume).

update_notes_v132_exclude_title.message: Exclude posts by keyword in creator downloads

update_notes_v132_exclude_desc.message: When you start a creator download, you can enter comma-separated keywords to exclude. Posts whose title contains a keyword (e.g. WIP) are skipped, and the keywords are filled in again next time.

update_notes_v132_navigation_desc.message: You can move to other pages on the site during a creator download, and the progress notice stays on screen. Closing or reloading the tab stops posts that have not started yet.

update_notes_v132_cancel_title.message: Fixed cancel not taking effect in creator downloads

update_notes_v132_cancel_desc.message: Pressing Cancel used to keep downloading every file already in the queue. Remaining and in-progress files are now cancelled too, and you can also cancel while waiting for downloads to finish.

update_notes_v132_stall_desc.message: A download is cancelled if the server sends nothing for 30 seconds or it stops making progress for 1 minute. A failed file frees its slot so the next files start first, then is retried from the end of the queue a little later. Files whose originals are gone from the site can't be downloaded no matter how long you wait, so a file is marked failed after about 2 minutes. Posts whose info could not be loaded are skipped and retried at the end of the list, and the number of files left is shown while waiting for downloads to finish.

update_notes_v132_pace_title.message: Up to 5 simultaneous downloads, faster skipping of downloaded posts

update_notes_v132_pace_desc.message: Simultaneous downloads are now limited to 1–5 so the server does not drop connections (the old 0 becomes 5). Creator downloads wait for the download queue to shrink before moving on to the next post, and in 'extension record' mode posts that were fully downloaded are skipped right away without loading their info.

update_notes_v132_records_desc.message: Downloaded file and post records are now stored one by one, so the browser no longer slows down during downloads even with thousands of records. Existing records are moved over automatically.

update_notes_v132_text_title.message: Post text file no longer counts as a success

update_notes_v132_text_desc.message: For posts with images or attachments, a saved post text file alone no longer makes the post count as downloaded or partly failed. Text-only posts are judged by the text file.

update_notes_v132_hint_title.message: Server issue note on failure notices

update_notes_v132_hint_desc.message: When downloads fail, the notice now explains that the problem may be on the kemono / pawchive server rather than in the extension, and what to try.

update_notes_v132_progress_title.message: Download progress for a single post

update_notes_v132_progress_desc.message: Downloading one post now shows how many files are done and how many are retrying, and you can cancel it from the notification. While cancelling (creator downloads too), it shows how many files are left to clean up.

update_notes_v131_skip_title.message: Skip files that were already downloaded

update_notes_v131_skip_desc.message: Settings can now skip files you already downloaded, based on the extension's own record or the browser download history. A batch that stopped halfway no longer has to start over.

update_notes_v131_status_desc.message: Creator page cards (bottom right) and post titles now show whether a post was downloaded (✓), partly failed (⚠), or failed (✕).

update_notes_v131_history_desc.message: Export or import the downloaded file and post history as a JSON file from Settings to keep using it in another browser.

update_notes_v131_stuck_title.message: Fixed creator downloads stuck while waiting to finish

update_notes_v131_stuck_desc.message: If a file still failed after all retries, the "Waiting for downloads to finish…" message never went away. This is fixed.

update_notes_v131_paging_title.message: Fixed creator downloads not starting on some creator pages

update_notes_v131_paging_desc.message: Requesting the page after the last one in the post list caused an error, so the download never started. This is fixed.

update_notes_v130_creator_title.message: Download all posts from a creator page

update_notes_v130_creator_desc.message: Use the shortcut or right-click menu on a creator page to download every post from that creator at once. Includes a confirmation prompt, a progress display with a cancel button, and an automatic wait-and-retry when the server limits requests.

update_notes_v130_concurrent_desc.message: Set how many files download at the same time. Set it to 1 to download files one after another. (0 = unlimited)

update_notes_v130_api_title.message: Post data now comes from the API

update_notes_v130_api_desc.message: Post information is read from the site API instead of the page HTML, so downloads keep working when the site layout changes. Images and attachments are separated by file extension.

update_notes_v130_server_desc.message: Each file is downloaded from the server it is stored on (n1, n2, file, etc.) or from its temporary download link.

update_notes_v130_toast_desc.message: Fixed notifications appearing as plain text stuck to the right edge after moving to another page.

update_notes_history_v128.message: v1.2.8 — Fixed the post upload time macro showing the wrong time

update_notes_history_v126.message: v1.2.6 — Added support for downloading from pawchive.st, a site suspiciously similar to Kemono.

help_retry_count.message:
Specifies the maximum number of times a failed download will be retried.
Set to 0 to disable automatic retries.

help_download_delay.message:
Specifies the wait time in milliseconds between starting one file download and the next.
Increase this value if downloads fail due to too many requests. Default: 150.

options_conflict_action.message: If a file with the same name already exists

help_conflict_action.message:
Specifies what happens when a file with the same name already exists in the save folder, for example when you download the same post again.
Overwrite prevents files like 001(1).jpg from being created.
When using it, make sure your rename macros produce a different path for each post (e.g. include the title or page ID macro). Otherwise files from different posts may overwrite each other.

help_notification_format.message:
Specifies the format of the toast notification that appears when a download batch completes.
Macros are supported. Only general macros and time macros can be used.

prompt_creator_exclude.message:
Download $1 posts from this creator.
Posts whose title contains any of the keywords below are skipped. Separate keywords with commas (,), or leave empty to download everything. (e.g. WIP, draft)

notify_creator_navigation.message: You can move to other pages on the site while downloading. Closing or reloading the tab stops posts that have not started yet.

confirm_creator_download_excluded.message: Exclude $2 of $1 posts and download the remaining $3?

notify_creator_all_excluded.message: Every post matched an excluded keyword, so there is nothing to download

notify_preview_only_body.message: Files whose originals are not on the site are downloaded as preview (thumbnail) images. They may be lower quality than the original.

notify_preview_only_once.message: This notice is shown only once per creator download.

notify_status_queue_full.message: ⏸ Queue is full, waiting before the next post (queue $1 · retrying $2)

notify_status_waiting_turn.message: ⏸ Waiting for earlier downloads to finish

notify_creator_cancelling.message: Cancelling… cleaning up the remaining downloads

notify_server_issue_hint.message: If downloads fail only in bulk but work one at a time, or the server does not respond at all, the problem may be on the kemono / pawchive server rather than in this extension. Try that post on its own or try again later.

options_skip_downloaded.message: Skip files that were already downloaded

help_skip_downloaded.message:
Skips files that were already downloaded when downloading again.
  • Extension record: the extension remembers each file it saved successfully (failed files are removed from the record). Works even if you clear the browser's download list, but files you deleted yourself are still skipped; clear the record below if needed.
  • Browser download history: checks the browser's download list for a finished download with the same file name whose file still exists on disk. Deleted files are downloaded again, but clearing the browser's download list makes everything download again.

confirm_clear_download_history.message: Clear the history of downloaded files? Every file will be downloaded again next time.

notify_download_history_imported.message: Imported $1 file records and $2 post records.

notify_download_history_import_failed.message: Could not read the file. Choose a history file exported from this extension.
